<!-- Generated by scripts/api-reference.mjs from src/data/openapi.json: do not edit, run `task refs`. -->

- `POST /api/v1/applications` — Public: start an application for an offer
- `GET /api/v1/applications/{application_id}` — The application, for whoever holds its secret
- `PUT /api/v1/applications/{application_id}/answers` — Save the typed answers, checked against the form
- `POST /api/v1/applications/{application_id}/files` — Upload a file for one of the form's file fields (replaces the last)
- `DELETE /api/v1/applications/{application_id}/files/{key}` — Remove an uploaded file
- `POST /api/v1/applications/{application_id}/wallet` — Ask the holder's wallet: pair (QR 1), present credentials, submit (QR 2) or receive the credential (QR 3)
- `GET /api/v1/applications/{application_id}/wallet` — Whether the wallet has answered the request in course (the catalog polls)
- `POST /api/v1/applications/{application_id}/collect` — The holder's wallet asks to receive its issued credential
- `GET /api/v1/applications/{application_id}/request` — The wallet request in course, as the wallet reads it
- `POST /api/v1/applications/{application_id}/request/response` — The wallet's answer: an `id_token`, a `vp_token` or a `signature`; for `receive`, an `id_token` answered with the credential
- `GET /api/v1/catalog/issuers/{issuer_slug}/offers/{type_id}` — Public: an issuer's offer of a credential type, with its form
- `GET /api/v1/catalog/offers` — Public: every published issuer's offers, newest issuer first
- `GET /api/v1/catalog/offers/categories` — Public: the categories offers are filed under, with how many each has
- `GET /api/v1/catalog/issuers/{issuer_slug}/offers` — Public: a published issuer and everything it offers
- `GET /api/v1/tenants/{tenant_id}/applications` — The applications the tenant's issuers received, newest first, a page at a time
- `GET /api/v1/tenants/{tenant_id}/applications/{application_id}` — One received application: what the holder signed, and whether it holds
- `GET /api/v1/tenants/{tenant_id}/applications/{application_id}/files/{key}` — A file the holder uploaded, as uploaded
- `POST /api/v1/tenants/{tenant_id}/applications/{application_id}/decision` — Accept or reject a submitted application (any member)
- `GET /api/v1/tenants/{tenant_id}/applications/{application_id}/issuance` — The credential to issue: its claims, proposed from the application
- `PUT /api/v1/tenants/{tenant_id}/applications/{application_id}/issuance` — Settle the credential's claims and validity (the draft its signer signs)
- `POST /api/v1/tenants/{tenant_id}/applications/{application_id}/issuance/sign` — Ask the issuer's signer's wallet to sign the credential (the draft)

## Public: start an application for an offer

`POST /api/v1/applications` · public

**Body** (`application/json`): [StartIn](/reference/api/schemas/#startin)

| Field | Type | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `issuer` | string | max length 64 |
| `type` | string | max length 64 |

| Status | Answer |
| --- | --- |
| 201 | [Started](/reference/api/schemas/#started) |
| 404 | [`offer_not_found`](/reference/errors/#offer_not_found) |
| 422 | [HTTPValidationError](/reference/api/schemas/#httpvalidationerror) — Validation Error |
| 429 | [`too_many_requests`](/reference/errors/#too_many_requests): too many from the network address |

## The holder's wallet asks to receive its issued credential

`POST /api/v1/applications/{application_id}/collect` · public

The wallet proves it is the holder and gets a `receive` request,
answered as the catalog's QR 3 is.

| Parameter | In | Type | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `application_id` | path | string (uuid) |  |

**Body** (`application/json`): [CollectIn](/reference/api/schemas/#collectin)

| Field | Type | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id_token` | string | max length 8192 |

| Status | Answer |
| --- | --- |
| 200 | object |
| 400 | [`invalid_token`](/reference/errors/#invalid_token), [`invalid_did`](/reference/errors/#invalid_did) |
| 404 | [`application_not_found`](/reference/errors/#application_not_found) |
| 409 | [`not_issued`](/reference/errors/#not_issued), [`already_received`](/reference/errors/#already_received) |
| 422 | [HTTPValidationError](/reference/api/schemas/#httpvalidationerror) — Validation Error |
